duplicateAssessment: No existing Dong Bai, LianZhu or XiaHui registration found in bounded Core/content search.
versionAssessment: Current official page and current client293/294 agree in rule wording; client uses HTML line break formatting. No old/mobile revision merged.
mechanismGaps: Recipient-controlled black LianZhu choice, exact two legal discard cards or owner draw2; owning frame must retain revealed gift invoice and await actual movement children before continuing.

XiaHui requires exact physical entity restrictions tied to actual recipient and native gain provenance, covering Use, Respond, view-as materials and recipient voluntary Discard; existing kind/category bans cannot substitute exact-card restrictions.

Release restrictions only after actual recipient HP decreases, including source-free loss and damage becoming HP loss; prevention or recovery must not release. Track recipient lifetime and entity movement without stale use-ID sidecars.
Black owner hand-limit exclusion needs current owner-effective black classification. Existing kind and per-entity temporary exemptions provide query hooks but not this persistent dynamic suit policy.
existingEntryPoints: ProgramRecipientContestConsequences.cs: real gift plus recipient consequence precedent
interpretationBoundaries: Current gain text does not restrict original owner zone to hand. Need preserve original owner source and black classification at actual transfer, rather than only LianZhu cards.
LianZhu activation source zones and HE discard scope are not explicitly enumerated by these primary texts; no fresh formal FAQ captured.

Transferred locked card leaving recipient, re-entering, source skill loss and owner death require explicit source-right lifetime choice supported by primary evidence; no automatic premature expiry assumed.
Cannot discard refers recipient restriction; do not automatically prohibit other players from discarding or obtaining these cards.

implementationInterpretations: Exact current293 nonblack gift finishes without owner draw; do not copy a different LianZhu revision with automatic nonblack draw.
Activation gives exactly one original owner hand card. Black classification freezes original owner-effective suit before reveal and actual gift.
Every actual source grant contributes its own source/instance and gameplay hash. Restrictions survive original source skill loss and death once issued.
Restriction ends when the physical card leaves recipient hand; returning it later without a new original source hand gain does not revive old restriction.
Recipient actual HP decrease releases every issued restriction; prevention or recovery does not. Recipient death clears remaining restrictions.
Only recipient voluntary discard is forbidden. An actual foreign forced discard, obtaining or transfer is not forbidden by this wording.
If recipient has fewer than two legal HE discard entities after gain children, only owner draw branch is available. Owner death skips actual draw but drains once-issued children.

Current294 obtained black cards includes source-owned equipment and other owned zones, not only source hand. Native movement builder freezes every original policy source, instance, gameplay hash and original owner-effective suit before moving; actual recipient Hand gain consumes that frozen source list even if an original source disappears during the same invocation.
